summary: 066 finding R065-001 is converged. Product archive Guidance HOW will not execute before ActionPackage formation. The revised Explore explicitly requires one bounded single-Action execution-order seam: stage prepared locally, resolve exact GuidanceRef and form the exact ActionPackage, run a read-only package-bound preparation check, preserve the pre-invocation currentAction on preparation BLOCKED/failure, and only then continue the existing execution/admission/terminal path on PASS.
blockingUnknown: Native Windows execution remains required later to prove the exact Windows ACL fixture and eliminate the two Windows-only proof skips; this remains an implementation/review acceptance obligation, not an Explore contract blocker.
specDelta: MODIFY single-action-execution-terminal-boundary for atomic package-bound preparation outcome ordering; MODIFY action-guidance-execution so the same exact ActionPackage/Guidance identity binds preparation and execution HOW; MODIFY author-action-guidance for archive readiness/correction, continuation, stale current-truth cleanup, and generic proof-Explore concept/mutation-order discipline; Windows work remains test mechanics for existing contracts
durableFacts: prepare is not a Standard Action and prepared/terminal remain the only Action lifecycle states.
No existing production host owns product Guidance HOW before ActionPackage formation; pre-package Guidance execution is contract-inconsistent.
A structurally valid prepared candidate can be staged locally, exact GuidanceRef resolved, and the existing ActionPackage formed before externally committing that staged currentAction.
A read-only preparation callback can consume that exact ActionPackage; blocked preparation can discard the staged candidate and preserve the pre-invocation terminal review-apply boundary.
With terminal review-apply preserved, existing Policy still admits Owner-controlled revise-apply correction.
Preparation PASS can continue the existing invoke/execution/admission/terminal path with the same exact ActionPackage identity.
The correction therefore needs a bounded Core execution-order/seam change but no new Action/state/package identity/control plane.
The remaining A/B/C/D/E scope is unchanged.
explicitNonGoals: new lifecycle state or Policy transition
